alt://fionama.com/wp-content/plugins/instagram-feed/img/placeholder.png|Homeownership is part of the California Dream and it was an honor to return as keynote speaker for My Way Home’s 5th Annual Leading People Home Awards Ceremony and 25th Anniversary Celebration. Congratulations to this year’s remarkable awardees: • Lynn L. Jacobs Excellence in Lifetime Leadership Award: Celina Zacharias, Port of Hueneme Harbor Commissioner.
